title: dynasimR: Analysis and visualisation of agent-based and discrete-event simulation output
description: dynasimR is a domain-neutral framework for analysing and visualising the output of discrete-event, agent-based and node-actor simulations. It targets systems in which entities move through states and interact within a spatial or network environment, regardless of the field the simulation comes from. Two interchangeable output schemas are supported and can be analysed through a single common interface, so that simulations written against different conventions do not require separate analysis code. The package includes an interactive dashboard and helpers for exporting publication-ready figures. It is intended for modellers who want a consistent post-processing layer independent of the simulation engine.
